title: Recall-Oriented Precise Binary-to-Source Function Matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.23546v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Binary-to-source function matching supports software composition analysis by identifying reused third-party code, but existing embedding-based approaches restrict subsequent refinement to initially retrieved candidates. When the correct source function is absent from this set, selecting or filtering the available candidates cannot recover the match. Inlining further complicates the retrieval by combining multiple source functions into one binary function. In this paper, we propose BScout to improve matching precision and uncover additional matches. BScout uses the positional information of existing matches to supplement candidates for unresolved binary functions, extending the search beyond the initial candidate set, and adopts composition-aware training to address the inlined composition matching. Large language models are adopted to select and review matches, while positional information also helps filter inconsistent results. Experime

translated_title: 面向召回率的精确二进制-源代码函数匹配
translated_abstract: 二进制到源代码的函数匹配通过识别被复用的第三方代码来支持软件成分分析，但现有的基于嵌入的方法将后续的精细化处理限制在最初检索到的候选集中。当正确的源函数不在这个集合中时，对现有候选进行选择或过滤无法恢复匹配。内联技术通过将多个源函数组合成一个二进制函数，进一步增加了检索的复杂性。在本文中，我们提出BScout来提高匹配精度并发现额外的匹配。BScout利用已有匹配的位置信息为未解析的二进制函数补充候选，将搜索范围扩展到初始候选集之外，并采用组合感知训练来解决内联组合匹配问题。该方法采用大语言模型来选择和审查匹配结果，同时位置信息也有助于过滤不一致的结果。实验……
tldr: BScout通过利用已有匹配的位置信息将搜索范围扩展到初始候选集之外，并采用组合感知训练与大语言模型审查，从而在处理内联函数的同时提高二进制-源代码函数匹配的精确率和召回率。
en_tdlr: BScout improves binary-to-source function matching by leveraging positional information of existing matches to extend the search beyond initial candidate sets, adopting composition-aware training for inlined functions, and using large language models to select and review matches.
